body: Deep-dive-generated forward test (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Live deep dive #1, company drawn at random (method test, L9/L21). Probability 0.46 (naive base rate 0.44) that: SUNFLAG's price return from 20-Nov-2026 (close Rs 368.60) to 30-Sep-2027 beats the Nifty 500 (close 24,088.80 on 20-Nov-2026). Our reasoning: no edge claimed on LMEL (beta 0.73, weekly corr 0.54 over 2 years); the market-cap/stake ratio (0.64) sits a little below its 3-year average (~0.71), a slight tailwind if it mean-reverts; high-beta to the market (1.5 vs Nifty 500). Naive base: share of Indian small caps that beat the broad index over ~10 months, typically a little below half because returns are right-skewed [EST, unverified]. Resolution: YES if (SUNFLAG.NS close on the last trading day on or before 30-Sep-2027 / 368.60) > (^CRSLDX close on the same day / 24,088.80); split-adjusted closes, dividends ignored (Rs 1/yr, ~0.3%). Source: Yahoo v8 daily closes SUNFLAG.NS and ^CRSLDX (NSE bhavcopy as check). Resolve by 2027-09-30; score with Brier vs the base rate to test whether deep-dive probabilities beat naive base rates.
